title: Streamer.bot OBS Automatic Low Bitrate Switching
extensionText: Low Bitrate Scene Switcher for IRL Streaming

options.name: sboalbsObsConnection
options.label: OBS Connection Index
options.description: Zero-indexed position of OBS Connection in Stream Apps > OBS

options.name: sboalbsBitrateOverlay
options.label: Bitrate Overlay
options.description: Set whether to use Bitrate Overlay displaying the current bitrate on stream

options.name: sboalbsBitrateSourceName
options.label: Bitrate Overlay Source Name
options.description: The name of the OBS Text Source that will display your current bitrate

options.name: sboalbsOfflineToLow
options.label: Offline scene to Low scene
options.description: Allow switching from offline scene to low bitrate scene

options.name: sboalbsSceneLive
options.label: Live Scene Name
options.description: OBS Scene to switch to when bitrate is above than the Low Scene Bitrate Trigger

options.name: sboalbsSceneLow
options.label: Low Bitrate Scene Name
options.description: OBS Scene to switch to when bitrate is under than the Low Scene Bitrate Trigger

options.name: sboalbsSceneOffline
options.label: Offline Scene Name
options.description: OBS Scene to switch to when bitrate is under than the Low Scene Offline Trigger

options.name: sboalbsTriggerLowBitrate
options.label: Low Scene Bitrate Trigger
options.description: Bitrates lower than this will switch to the low bitrate scene

options.name: sboalbsTriggerLowRtt
options.label: Low Scene RTT Trigger
options.description: RTT (ping) higher than this will switch to the low bitrate scene

options.name: sboalbsTriggerOfflineBitrate
options.label: Offline Scene Bitrate Trigger
options.description: Bitrates lower than this will switch to the offline scene

options.name: sboalbsTriggerOfflineRtt
options.label: Offline Scene RTT Trigger
options.description: RTT (ping) higher than this will switch to the offline scene

options.name: bitrateCalculation
options.label: Bitrate Calculation
options.description: These options are for how the average bitrate is calculated

options.name: sboalbsInterval
options.label: Interval
options.description: This is the number of seconds between each time SBOALBS retrieves the current bitrate

options.name: sboalbsIterations
options.label: Iterations
options.description: This is the number of times SBOALBS will retrieve the current bitrate before calculating the average bitrate

options.name: sboalbsSendAllPlatforms
options.label: Send Message All Platforms
options.description: Allow sending messages from SBOALBS to all connected platforms

options.name: sboalbsSendAsBot
options.label: Send Message As Bot
options.description: Allow sending messages from SBOALBS as bot account

options.name: sboalbsSendFallback
options.label: Send Message With Fallback to Broadcaster
options.description: If sending as bot fails, send as broadcaster account instead
